purpose: Source-bound extended metric scenarios and native objective qualification; protocol 1.0 remains frozen.

decision_rules.primary: One metric chosen before outcomes; all declared qualification panels must improve. No best-of-metrics selection or composite score.
decision_rules.improvement: Native exact/gap decisions. For resources the upper 95% confidence bound on Agent/Base minus one must be strictly below zero. No universal minimum percent gain.
decision_rules.confirmation: Fresh full Judge repeat with the same task, patch, image, harness, CPU/memory/cpuset and grid, reversed Base/Agent order; both runs must improve and pass all guardrails.
decision_rules.guardrails: Tasks explicitly declare allowed degradation in canonical absolute or relative units. The adverse confidence bound must be no greater than that limit. Missing declarations => needs_protocol.
decision_rules.required_tradeoffs: Cover solution quality/exact coverage, compute cost/exact PAR2 runtime, and peak RSS. Primary covers its own metric. Required guards cover every qualification panel. Extra control panels are allowed; final reporting panels cannot select tasks.
decision_rules.correctness: Independent semantic verification and complete run evidence are mandatory. Resource savings cannot excuse invalid solutions, bounds, optimum or infeasibility claims.
decision_rules.pending: Missing scenario/collector rules => needs_protocol; missing paired measurements => incomplete; no significant direction => inconclusive. These are not automatic rejections.
decision_rules.panels: Qualification and final reporting panels are disjoint frozen task instance sets. Qualification-selected effects are not independent final estimates.
decision_rules.registration: Freeze task/source/protocol hashes before measured runs. Judge checkpoints bind that task hash and record measurement start time. Revised plans require fresh runs.
decision_rules.admission: Recomputed hash-bound confirmed improvement plus passing guardrails satisfies expert_reference performance_confirmed. Other source/build/workload/correctness/integration gates still apply. open_opportunity retains its baseline route without requiring human improvement.

bootstrap.method: Native instance bootstrap of log per-instance ratios; geometric mean estimator unchanged.
bootstrap.seed_robustness: Existing 99% paired seed-list bootstrap unchanged; declare dispersion variant before primary qualification.
bootstrap.controlled_transfer: Existing simultaneous retention protocol unchanged; not replaced by generic scalar inference.

scenario_protocol.task_binding: Freeze task, patch, binding fingerprints, model sequence hashes, protocol choices and complete expected grid before measurement.
scenario_protocol.trajectory: Independently verify every time-stamped incumbent. Ignore late solutions. Censor first-passage times with the declared budget/PAR2 rule. Step integrals hold final states to the budget and use declared reference, positive scale and initial missing loss; preserve signed losses.
scenario_protocol.dual: Independently evaluate weak-duality LP-relaxation certificates with exact rational arithmetic and outward rounding. A solver-reported search bound alone is insufficient.
scenario_protocol.lifecycle: Use one boot/process identity, current resident memory after the declared reset and cleanup policy, an explicit warm-up prefix, declared series reduction and OLS growth in bytes per solve.
scenario_protocol.scaling: Use a fixed thread grid and common predeclared quality target. Speedup is T(reference)/T(threads); efficiency divides by threads/reference_threads. Censored and zero target times cannot establish efficiency. Declare curve reduction before collection.
scenario_protocol.sequence: Cold and warm modes execute identical hash-bound model sequences. Cold reloads objects; warm applies supported in-place updates. Sum solve and update times for the declared scored mode; no missing steps.
scenario_protocol.numerical: Independently recompute row, bound and integrality violations on the declared stress grid. Preserve failures and expected denominators.
scenario_protocol.replay: Compare every pair of identical-input/seed/resource repeats on declared fields and explicit tolerances. Report matching pairs over declared pairs.
scenario_protocol.setup: Measure binding API initialization/model loading including marshalling, excluding Python startup. Memory is the sampled stage RSS peak with declared resolution, not process-lifetime peak RSS.
scenario_protocol.native_robustness: Preserve native seed statistics and 99% paired seed bootstrap; reuse Type-7 representation IQR, declared boundary counts and simultaneous controlled transfer.
scenario_protocol.confirmation: Identical design hash and candidate, distinct collection ID, reversed Base/Agent order, and repeat start after initial finish. Independent full Judge confirmation and correctness guardrails also remain mandatory.
